topic: Cheaper per-lane isolation than full git worktrees: sparse or partial checkouts, shallow and reference clones, overlay or copy-on-write filesystems, single worktree with per-lane write redirection, per-lane sandboxed working directories with a shared object store, and one-checkout exact-attribution variants. For each: setup cost, disk cost, attribution exactness, what breaks (symlinked dependency roots, workspace self-links, compiled entry-point guards, the churn detector), and whether git worktree move or relocation survives.
